mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in supply, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.1% in 1 month
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure, which leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a growing economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% in 1 month
regime_hint: growing economy with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
